analysis: OpenROAD's STA on the routed database with the extracted SPEF. The typical corner reproduces ORFS's own final report (setup WNS +4.893 ns, hold WNS +0.119 ns). An earlier analysis that read 6_final.v instead left about 4,300 nets without parasitics, because ORFS omits the antenna diodes from that netlist while the SPEF refers to them.
note: the first integrated chip (original engines, 99,536-cycle decapsulation window); only the method note of its corner analysis is kept, because its published corner figures read the asynchronous reset path group instead of the core clock group
